description: The null/undefined early-exit check compares against pathArray.length instead of pathArray.length - 1, so it fires one segment too early and returns the default before reaching the last key
productionImpact: For any path with two or more segments, hitting `undefined` or `null` at the second-to-last segment now always returns the default value even when the final property exists. Every multi-level read in the application silently misses its target, causing UI fields, config values, and database writes to fall back to defaults and corrupt stored state.
